name: SeamlessIDX
author: seamlessidx

sections.description:
SeamlessIDX renders your MLS listings as real, crawlable pages on your own domain — a search results page and individual listing detail pages, both server-rendered so search engines index them as genuinely belonging to your site.

Every setting that shapes how your listings and search bar look — branding colors and font, which price points appear in your Min/Max Price dropdowns, your map style, your registration wall, your chat widget — is pulled from your existing SeamlessIDX dashboard. Nothing to configure twice.

Hero search bar

Add a search bar to your home page with the [seamlessidx_search_bar] shortcode, in the same four styles your SeamlessIDX dashboard offers: style="minimal", "filters", "wide" or "half". It’s built into the page (no iframe), uses your Primary Color and price points, and inherits your theme’s font.

Requires

  • A SeamlessIDX account with an API key (Settings → WordPress Integration in your SeamlessIDX portal)

External services

This plugin needs the services below to work.

SeamlessIDX

SeamlessIDX (https://seamlessidx.com) provides the listing data, your account settings and lead delivery. Your WordPress site connects to it using your API key.

  • When you click Connect to SeamlessIDX: your browser goes to your SeamlessIDX portal with this site’s address; after you approve, this site sends a one-time code and its address to SeamlessIDX and receives your API key.
  • When a search or listing page loads, or settings refresh: your search filters, the listing being viewed and your API key are sent, to get listings, cities and your branding settings.
  • When a visitor sends a question or tour request: their name, email, phone, message, and the listing’s address and ID are sent, so the lead reaches you.
  • When a visitor saves a search: their email, the search name and its filters are sent.
  • When a visitor opens AI insights or uses Ask AI (Pro and Brokerage plans): the listing ID and the conversation are sent, to generate the answer.
  • When a listing page shows the chat widget (Pro and Brokerage plans): the visitor’s browser loads it directly from seamlessidx.com, with the listing’s address and ID, so SeamlessIDX receives the visitor’s IP address.

SeamlessIDX Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Mapbox

Mapbox provides the maps. On the plugin’s search and listing pages, the visitor’s browser loads the Mapbox GL JS code, styles and map images from Mapbox, which receives the visitor’s IP address and the map area being viewed.

Mapbox Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Listing photos

Listing photos load in the visitor’s browser from the image addresses in the listing data, so those image hosts receive the visitor’s IP address. The hosts depend on your MLS.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the seamlessidx folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip directly from your WordPress admin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → SeamlessIDX and click Connect to SeamlessIDX. Sign in to your SeamlessIDX portal and approve this site (or paste your API key instead). Then choose the URL slug where your search page should live (e.g. properties).
  4. Save. Your search page is now live at yoursite.com/properties/.
sections.faq:
What happens to my listings if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating only unlinks this WordPress install — your SeamlessIDX account and data are untouched. You can reactivate or install on a different site at any time.

How do I add a search bar to my home page?

Edit the page and add a Shortcode block containing [seamlessidx_search_bar style="wide"] (or minimal, filters, half). Settings → SeamlessIDX lists all four. The Half-Page style’s title can be changed with heading="...". Wide and Half-Page also show shortcuts to the cities set in your dashboard’s Search Map Default.

Where do the search bar’s Price options come from?

Your SeamlessIDX dashboard’s Display Options settings — the same list your hosted SeamlessIDX site (if you have one) already uses.
sections.changelog:
1.11.1

  • Search box and form fields keep their own look on themes that style every text box (for example Hello Elementor): the search icon no longer sits on top of the placeholder text.

1.11.0

  • City pages: the introduction you write and approve in your Seamless IDX portal (Website Checkup → Draft it for me → City page intro) now appears at the top of that city’s page, above the live listing numbers.

1.10.3

  • While your MLS isn’t connected yet, your search and listing pages show sample homes. Those pages now tell search engines not to index them, and the listings sitemap stays empty. Both switch back on automatically once your MLS is connected.

1.10.2

  • Listing pages: “Nearby Schools” and “Flood Zone” headings now match the “Neighborhood” heading, with icons in your brand color.

1.10.1

  • Every listing now shows its flood zone status. Homes outside FEMA’s mapped risk zones read “Not in a FEMA-mapped flood zone”, with a note that unstudied areas can still flood.

1.10.0

  • New: a Neighborhood section on every listing page, built into the page so search engines read it too. It shows the closest groceries, coffee shops, restaurants and parks, the nearest public schools with grades and district (Pro and Brokerage), and the FEMA flood zone when the home is in one. School ratings are not shown.
  • The old sample “Nearby Schools” box with ratings is gone.

1.9.0

  • New: [seamlessidx_hotsheet id=”…”] shortcode. Put any of your hotsheets on a page or post, with the homes as part of the page itself. Unlike the embed code, search engines count them as your page’s content, and each home opens on this site. Copy it from Portal → Hotsheets → WordPress plugin.

1.8.0

  • New: automatic community and price-range pages, such as /homes/city/orlando/oakmont-reserve/ and /homes/city/orlando/under-300k/, built from your own MLS listings, the same ones your SeamlessIDX site has. Each has its own title, live numbers, a short Q&A, links to the other areas, and a place in your sitemap. A page appears when an area has at least 3 homes for sale and goes away when it doesn’t.

1.7.7

  • Homes clicked in your hotsheets and in SeamlessIDX alert and follow-up emails now open on this site, instead of your seamlessidx.com page. Short or outdated listing links redirect to the listing’s full address.

1.7.6

  • Faster first paint: the main listing photo, and the first listing photos on search and city pages, load first instead of being held back by lazy loading.

1.7.5

  • Faster pages: the map library now loads only when a map is about to come into view, instead of on every listing and search page.
  • City pages open with a line of live numbers for that city (homes listed and price range), and page 2 onward stays on the city page.
  • Each page of results has its own canonical link, and search, city and listing pages carry breadcrumb and results-list structured data.

1.7.4

  • Block themes (Twenty Twenty-Three, Four, Five and other full-site-editing themes): listing and search pages now use your theme’s own header, menu and footer, instead of WordPress’s plain fallback header.

1.7.3

  • Listing pages have one proper main heading: the address. WordPress no longer treats listing and search pages as your homepage, so themes don’t add your site name as a second main heading.
  • With a registration wall on, listings now carry Google’s markup for sign-up-gated content, so showing search engines the full listing isn’t mistaken for cloaking.

1.7.2

  • Works with Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO: listings are now in their sitemaps, and on listing and search pages they no longer print the homepage’s title, description, canonical link or schema next to ours.
  • New listings sitemap at /your-search-slug/sitemap.xml, also listed in robots.txt, with city pages and each listing’s last-changed date.
  • Listings shared on Facebook, in texts or Slack now show the photo, price and address.
  • Your hosted SeamlessIDX site steps out of search engines once this site is connected, so it doesn’t compete with your own listing pages.

1.7.1

  • Listing pages now show “Information last updated” with the date the MLS last changed the listing, and the MLS copyright line, as MLS display rules require.

1.7.0

  • New: Connect to SeamlessIDX — sign in to your SeamlessIDX portal and approve this site; no API key to copy and paste. Pasting a key still works.

1.6.3

  • Security: the AI Insights and Ask AI buttons now send a security token (nonce) with each request, like the contact and saved-search forms already do.

1.6.2

  • Security: stricter cleaning of what visitors submit, and of the icons printed on pages. Nothing changes in how your pages look or work.
  • Internal: changes needed for the WordPress.org plugin directory.

1.6.1

  • New: a Refresh from SeamlessIDX button in Settings → SeamlessIDX, so dashboard changes such as your logo or colors show right away.
  • Change: dashboard changes now appear on their own within an hour, instead of up to 12 hours.

1.6.0

  • New: open house dates on listing cards and pages, with a search filter.
  • New: virtual tour badges and buttons, with a search filter.
  • New: search by monthly payment, with an estimated payment on each card.
  • New: Ask AI about this home (Pro and Brokerage). Conversations stay in the buyer’s browser and aren’t stored.
  • Change: which features appear now follows your SeamlessIDX plan automatically, so moving between plans doesn’t need a plugin update.

1.5.2

  • New: a Listing Data Terms page, linked from your search and listing pages. It covers personal use, scraping and AI tools, as the MLS’s AI rules require.

1.5.1

  • Fix: listing cards and pages show the real MLS number instead of the feed’s internal record key.
  • Change: AI Insights now load only when a buyer clicks “Show AI insights”, and are no longer stored on your WordPress site. Insights cached by earlier versions are removed on update. AI Insights are hidden when AI features are turned off for your account.

1.5.0

  • New: [seamlessidx_search_bar] shortcode — a hero search bar for any page in four styles (minimal, filters, wide, half), matching the styles in the SeamlessIDX dashboard’s Website Embeds. Uses your Primary Color and price points; Wide and Half-Page show shortcuts to your Search Map Default cities.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: search results page, listing detail pages, XML sitemap, brand-driven rendering.
